[LSER.14.5.1] `sample <n>` declares a uniform-random reservoir of
size `n` over the slot's unbounded history. Its semantics
([LSMP.1]), aggregation applicability ([LSMP.3]),
the `SeriesBackendReservoir` backing ([LSMP.5]), and — notably — its **determinism**
([LSMP.2]; replay-deterministic and cross-platform bit-exact via a fixed-seed
integer PRNG) are specified in [LSMP].
